svg.text: BOT_MODE selects the transport; everything after the Update object is identical.
dispatch scheduled as a task, 200 OK returned first
included first so payment events never hit a broad F.text filter
one Router per bot, resolved by BOT_SPECS.router_path
dispatcher workflow data is injected per bot, never global
Isolation guarantee: a handler in bot_pdf cannot observe an update routed to bot_voice — separate Dispatcher, separate FSM prefix, separate history namespace.
